From clue 4: Percussionist lives somewhere to the right of history book buff.

But house 3 is pianist, so percussionist = house 2.  

From clue 1: Percussionist (house 2) lives somewhere to the left of the person who likes red.  
So red must be to the right of house 2 → red = house 3.  

Thus red lives in house 3.
